Early Facebook investor and Zynga founder Mark Pincus (@markpinc) vividly recalls the first time he met founder Mark Zuckerberg (@finkd).

"I was lucky enough that he [Napster founder Sean Parker] decided to bring Zuckerberg in my office when they were doing their very first pre-seed round or whatever it would be called today, but they raised $500,000 from Peter Thiel and Reid Hoffman (@reidhoffman) and me. And he came in and he was wearing those Hawaiian flip flops and basketball shorts. And he had his feet up on my conference table and handed me a card that said "I'm CEO, bitch." He was just having fun, did not care and was not looking to impress me in any way. And I was really impressed," Pincus told me in a new drop of my Power Players podcast on @YahooFinance.

From that meeting in the early 2000s, Pincus would go on to have lunch regularly with Zuckerberg as Facebook and Zynga's growth were accelerating at breakneck speeds.
